items.title: Change your phone number
items.reason: Telegram's API marks the code type for changing a number as reserved for the official Android and iOS apps. Quill has the code for it but won't turn it on until it's confirmed to be allowed.

items.title: Sign-ups that require buying Premium in an app store
items.reason: The in-store purchase calls are limited to official apps. Quill stops with a clear message instead.

items.title: Show a QR code so another device can sign in
items.reason: Signing in to Quill with a QR code works. Showing a QR code from Quill for a different device has no screen yet.

items.title: Count the secret chats an ended session will close
items.reason: TDLib doesn't link secret chats to sessions, so there is nothing to count.

items.title: Full account data export
items.reason: Per-chat export works. The full account exporter is written but hasn't been tested from start to finish.

items.title: Add a chat to a community
items.reason: TDLib 1.8.68 can create, rename, re-photo and delete communities and set member permissions, but has no call for adding an existing chat.

items.title: Show or hide a chat inside a community
items.reason: The hidden flag can only be set when the community is created. TDLib has no call to change it later.

items.title: Community administrator rights
items.reason: TDLib describes administrator rights for communities but has no call to change them.

items.title: Echo cancellation and noise suppression settings
items.reason: Calls use the call engine's default audio processing. There are no switches for it yet.

items.title: Live video and screen sharing in group calls
items.reason: The code paths exist and pass mock tests, but haven't been tried in a real group call.

items.title: Signature on a gift bought from the Marketplace
items.reason: TDLib's resale purchase call takes a message and a privacy flag, but no signature.

items.title: Screenshot alerts and screenshot blocking on Linux
items.reason: Linux desktops have no standard way for an app to detect or block screenshots. On macOS and Windows, Quill keeps open secret chats out of screenshots and screen recordings.

items.title: Full VoiceOver navigation
items.reason: Quill exposes its interface to accessibility tools on macOS, but spoken navigation hasn't been checked in every screen.
